description: Complete pinout and hardware reference for M5Stack Core S3 development board

specifications.audio: AW88298 I2S audio amplifier + built-in speaker
specifications.buttons: Power (GPIO 0, BOOT), Reset (EN), Programmable button on screen

display.notes: ILI9342C driven via M5GFX/LovyanGFX. Default rotation: 0

imu.notes: BMI270 (accel+gyro) + BMM150 (magnetometer). Shared I2C bus with touch.

microphone.notes: SPM1423 PDM MEMS mic. Use ESP32-S3 I2S in PDM mode.

audio_amplifier.notes: AW88298 I2S DAC + amplifier. Mono output to built-in speaker.

sd_card.notes: Shared SPI bus with display (different CS). Max 32GB, FAT32.

grove_port.notes: Port A. I2C Grove connector. 5V power, 3.3V I2C signals (level-shifted). Built-in pull-ups.

gpio_header.notes: 8-pin GPIO header at bottom. Pins shared with Grove/other functions. Check conflicts.

rgb_led.notes: Single addressable RGB LED. Use FastLED or Adafruit NeoPixel library.

buzzer.notes: Drive with PWM for tones. Use ledc (ESP-IDF) or tone() (Arduino).

rtc.notes: BM8563 RTC. Shared I2C bus. Battery-backed via internal LiPo.

pmic.notes: AXP2101 PMIC. Power management, battery charging, power rails control.

key_pins.gpio_0: BOOT button. Pull LOW at reset to enter download/flash mode. Built-in pull-up.
key_pins.gpio_46: Strapping pin. Do NOT use as GPIO. Controls boot mode.
key_pins.notes: USB-C has built-in USB-to-Serial/JTAG (no external chip needed).

i2c_bus.notes: Shared I2C bus. All devices on same SDA(8)/SCL(9). Built-in pull-up resistors. External Grove devices share this bus.

development_tips.framework: Arduino (recommended for beginners) or ESP-IDF (for advanced)
development_tips.psram: Octal PSRAM enabled by default in Arduino. Use ps_malloc() or heap_caps_malloc(size, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM).
development_tips.debug: Built-in USB-JTAG. Use `openocd -f board/esp32s3-builtin.cfg` for debugging.

pin_conflicts.shared_spi: Display and SD share MOSI(23) and SCLK(18). Different CS pins.
pin_conflicts.grove_gpio: Grove SDA=1, SCL=2. If using GPIO header, avoid using 1 and 2 as GPIO.

platformio_template.ini:
[env:m5stack-cores3]
platform = espressif32
board = m5stack-cores3
framework = arduino
monitor_speed = 115200
upload_speed = 921600
board_build.flash_mode = qio
board_build.partitions = default_8MB.csv
build_flags =
    -D CORE_DEBUG_LEVEL=0
    -D BOARD_HAS_PSRAM
    -mfix-esp32-psram-cache-issue
lib_deps =
    m5stack/M5Unified @ ^0.2.0
    m5stack/M5GFX @ ^0.2.0
